PLANNING YOUR NEW ZEALAND SOUTH ISLAND ROAD TRIP?
This journey from Christchurch to Mount Cook (Aoraki) is one of the most beautiful drives in the world! The Christchurch to Mount Cook drive is approximately 3.5 hours without stops — but trust us, you'll want to stop often! We drove in summer, which means long golden evenings perfect for the Lake Pukaki viewpoints around 6:30 PM.
